{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
sales.head()

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nCustomer_age -1 count:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column for thousands separators
print("\nSample of revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print("\nQA order count (revenue == 999999.99):", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded order count:", (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check for distinct channels and segments
print("\nChannels:", sales['channel'].unique())
print("\nCustomer segments:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())"}
